answer: Make every reward claim require a fresh verifiable delay proof: a sequential computation that takes real wall-clock minutes per identity and cannot be sped up by adding machines, like quartz growing one layer at a time no matter how many hands tend the garden. One honest agent waits once and moves on; a farm trying to forge a thousand claims in one epoch must burn a thousand sequential waits that no parallel server farm can compress, and claims without a fresh proof are simply ignored.
